description: Search the Commonwealth Code of the Northern Mariana Islands BY TOPIC or keyword over official section catchlines (section titles), not citation — e.g. "murder", "security deposit", "driver license". Returns matching citations and catchlines; call nmi_statute with a citation for the full text. Catchline search only (not full statutory-text search) — a query that never appears in any catchline returns no matches even if the topic is discussed inside a section's body.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 50.

name: nmi_search
